title: Snowy Hub | Auto Fish, Auto Perfect, TP, Inf Oxygen & More
features:
Full Auto Fish – Automatically handles the entire fishing process.

Native and Fast Fishing Modes – Choose between native and fast fishing methods.

Steady, Fast and Turbo Speed Presets – Select your preferred fishing speed.

Automatic Rod Equipping and Rod Selection – Automatically equips and selects the appropriate rod.

Adjustable Cast Power – Controls the strength of each cast.

Perfect Cast Support – Supports perfect casting.

Automatic State-Gated Shaking – Automatically performs shaking when the fishing state allows it.

Fast Automatic Reel Completion – Automatically completes the reeling process quickly.

Automatic Native Fallback – Switches to native fishing if fast fishing fails.

Duplicate Cast and Shake Prevention – Prevents duplicate casting and shaking actions.

Special Rod Minigame Support – Supports fishing minigames for special rods.

Adjustable Recast and Shake Timing – Adjusts delays between recasts and shakes.

Humanized Timing and Jitter Options – Adds configurable timing variation.

Automatic Fishing Stall Recovery – Recovers automatically if fishing becomes stuck.

Health Guard – Stops fishing when health drops below a selected minimum.

Lock Fishing Position – Keeps your character at the selected fishing position.

Manual Fishing State Reset – Manually resets the current fishing state.

Sell All Fish – Automatically sells all fish.

Auto Sell – Sells fish based on a timer or catch count.

Automatic Held-Fish Appraising – Automatically appraises held fish.

Appraiser Support – Supports Normal, Anywhere, Drowned, and Shady appraisers.

Appraisal Targets – Continues appraising until reaching a mutation, Shiny, Sparkling, or value target.

Adjustable Appraisal Roll Limit – Sets the maximum number of appraisal attempts.

Auto Favorite Fish – Automatically favorites selected fish.

Auto Favorite Eggs – Automatically favorites selected eggs.

Favorite Filters – Filters favorites by name, rarity, and mutation.

Minimum Weight Filter – Only favorites fish above a selected weight.

Automatic Rod Enchanting – Automatically enchants fishing rods.

Selectable Enchants – Selects desired relics and target enchants.

Adjustable Enchant Roll Limit – Sets the maximum number of enchant attempts.

Auto Claim Crab Cages – Automatically claims ready crab cages.

Auto Claim Rewards – Automatically collects available rewards.

Auto Collect Treasure – Automatically collects nearby treasure.

Treasure Collection Range – Adjusts the range for automatic treasure collection.

Automatic Totem Activation – Automatically activates totems during Day, Night, or Any-Time conditions.

Dynamic Totem and Relic Detection – Detects available totems and relics dynamically.

Travel Modes – Supports Emulated, Native, Tween, and Instant travel methods.

Fishing Spot Teleports – Teleports to fishing spots and zones.

NPC Teleports – Teleports to available NPCs.

Player Teleports – Teleports to selected players.

Treasure Teleports – Teleports to detected treasure.

Save and Return Position – Saves your current position and returns to it later.
